translations.web: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.
translations.bsb: And after looking around at all of them, He said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did so, and it was restored.
translations.kjv: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
translations.asv: And he looked round about on them all, and said unto him, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored.
